pack.law: failing packs are skipped — a lane that cannot fail is not evidence

anomaly_hits.note: §E factor; inert today because anomalies.json all_hits is empty in both lanes (D1 landed in B3a). It is wired so the queue re-prices itself the moment a detector fires.

matcher_rules.attribution: row lights a branch only if the card tag is the row's subject, cause, or in its data payload
matcher_rules.verb_presence: row.verb == predicate verb AND kind in signature kinds (if any) AND attributable; verb-CAST rows exclude subject==the card itself (13b: subject==card is the card's own casting, not the may-cast side)
matcher_rules.cast_attribution_caveat: 13b's KIND_CAST row has no source-permanent field, so a branch that needs an effect to cast another card is not attributable from the explicit CAST row alone; positive may-cast control lanes must expose an attributable world-diff row or a new engine instrumentation contract before these DARK rows can become LIT
matcher_rules.targeting_cardinality: TARGETING rows grouped by cause (designation source); ONE_OF branch lit by a group of size 1, REST branch lit by a group of size >= 2
matcher_rules.died_branch: CREATURE_DIES row caused by the card (cause attributable, subject a different object)
matcher_rules.eachplayer: lit by >=1 attributable fan-out row (fanout_n records the count; 2-player lanes mean each-opponent effects fan out to 1)

unmatchable_classes.mode-choice: chosen mode index predicate — choice data absent from every journalled data layout
unmatchable_classes.verb-tag: predicate verb never observed as any row's cause_verb (diff-journal cannot see that verb's effects)

meta.heat_formula: §E-faithful, DARK-gated: heat(branch) = dark x BCS x (1 + sum of §C class weights) x (1 + card anomaly_hits from anomalies.json); card rollup = dark_branch_count x mean(branch heat); ties by BCS then name then branch_id. Class weights are uniform 1.0 by calibration (every §C class has produced a real bug, nothing yet prices one above another); interaction_heat is a pair factor and enters in pair_coverage.py

life_goes_on_died_branch.computed: bcs.json B1 inventory declares 0 branches for Life Goes On — precedent not recomputable at branch level; its died-side evidence (LIFE_GAINED attributed to it) is PRESENT in the lanes
